name: AI Pulse

sources.title: Submit Your App — 'Submit your AI tool for review. We'll review it and add it to our directory if it meets our criteria.'

requirements: AI tools only — an AI tools directory with categorized reviews
Submission is editorially reviewed ('add it to our directory if it meets our criteria') — criteria not published
No fee mentioned on the submit page
preparation: Pricing facts: has free plan, has free trial, starting price in USD/mo (can be left empty if unavailable)
Up to 10 key features (chips added via Enter/+)
A contact email — 'We'll contact you if we need more information'
workflow: Fill app name, description, URL, category, pricing flags, up-to-10 key features, email
Submit for review and wait — contact happens only if they need more info
Accepted tools appear under /reviews or the AI Tools index
watchFor: No stated review timeline or criteria — opaque editorial process
A real monitored email is worth giving since follow-up questions go there
Pricing fields are structured (free plan/free trial flags + USD starting price) — have accurate numbers
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a review/listing page on aipulse.fyi (reachable from the AI Tools index or its category)
unknowns: Whether listings include a followed link
